title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
总统套房内。墙壁上挂着的时钟指向七点。距离他离开的时候，窗外灰蒙蒙的天空已经透出了一丝亮光。有一些起得早的纽约市民已经开始了晨跑。而陆白打开电视，不出意外，上面尽是美利坚官方放出来的一些烟雾弹，比如说谁谁谁出轨了，达克纳斯版块上又有几只科技股涨停，并没有任何有关卢克.邓肯的新闻。涉及到真正的超凡力量，美利坚政府拿出了不同于以往散漫作风的严谨，不仅让每个知情人签署了最高级别的保密协议，而且还严厉警告了各个社交媒体，让他们不得报道任何有关新闻。“是谁说美利坚言论自由来着？”期望的事情没有发生，陆白情绪有一些郁闷。不过他很快调整过来，告诫自己不用急。先是去楼下餐厅吃了个久违的现代早餐，满足了一番自己的食欲后，陆白才把注意力放到了倒霉蛋卢克.邓肯那边。......有一天突然获得了超能力该怎么办？？每个人中二时期都有过的幻想，突然降临在卢克.邓肯身上成真了。身为当事人的他却发现，自己并没有想象中那么高兴。更多的。是一种大仇得报之后的茫然。他不知道自己这身怪力是从哪来的，是神明的怜悯亦或是恶魔的馈赠，也不知道自己之后该去做什么？从曾经的‘家’匆匆逃离之后，他就这么漫无目的地在街上游走着。不知不觉间就来到了他之前选定的自杀地点——纽约布鲁克林大桥。这座大桥始建于1869年，桥身由上万根钢索吊离水面41米，是当年世界上最长的悬索桥，也是世界上首次以钢材建造的大桥，落成时被认为是继世界古代七大奇迹之后的第八大奇迹。也正因此，每年都有数以百万记的游客来此观光打卡。换了身衣服的卢克混在众多游客中并不起眼。直到身体出现异变后愈发灵敏的感官，察觉到周围有一些若有若无的视线盯着自己。他才猛地停了下来，目光有些警觉地扫视四周。“目标突然停了下来，很有可能已经察觉到了我们的存在，马上执行A计划。”一间挂满屏幕的指挥室内，忙碌了一夜未睡的乔治.詹特利目光死死盯着屏幕。现代社会，如果国家下定决心想要找一个人，那就是烧成灰也能将其翻出来。纽约警察局在调用全纽约的监控后，早早就发现了卢克.邓肯在街上游荡的身影。不过。由于还不确定目标的危险性，以及是否有收编的可能，他们目前还没有采取行动，只是派人牢牢盯住。没想到现在反而是他们率先暴露了。“是。”乔治.詹特利的命令通过无线电，很快传达到前线人员的耳中。纽约布鲁克林大桥上。

一个穿着格子衫，头发花白的白人老头满脸无奈地扭头看向身旁的年轻女人，叮嘱道：“你等会尽量不要开口，卢克那小子脾气有点倔，就跟他父亲一样，如果向他施压的话，可能会起到反效果。”“明白。”有着一头漂亮黑发，面容英气、身材高挑的女警克里斯汀点了点头。他们两人是乔治.詹特利制定的A计划执行人员。其中白人老头老约翰是一位已经退休了的纽约警察，同时也是卢克父亲生前的好友。而女警克里斯汀跟卢克母亲长相有几分相似，都有一头漂亮的黑发，而且都是印第安人和白人的混血。根据纽约警局临时召集的专家智囊团分析，在谈判交涉时有这样一位女性存在，有利于降低卢克.邓肯的警惕心。事实也正是如此。当身体肌肉都已经紧绷起来的卢克看到他们两人向自己走来时，并没有第一时间动手。反倒是老约翰上前给了他一个结实的拥抱，道谢道：“孩子，我得谢谢你留了强尼一命，没有让我这个老人失去自己最小的儿子。”？？？老约翰的这个操作顿时把卢克整不会了。他沉默了一会才闷声道：“约翰叔叔，我想你来，应该不只是想说这个吧？”说这话的时候，卢克还扭头看了一眼站在老约翰旁边，跟自己母亲面容有几分相似的女警克里斯汀。“当然。”虽然是带着任务来的，但老约翰很坦然，“他们打算招揽你，所以让我来给你做思想工作。”“不......”闻言卢克下意识就想拒绝。但老约翰却朝他摆了摆手道：“不用紧张，孩子，仔细想想你就知道这不一定是坏事，不是吗？？”“高额的薪水，远超常人的社会地位，只要你想，你就可以放下过去，展开一段崭新的生活，我想威廉还有安娜他们如果在天堂知道这件事的话，也一定会为此感到欣慰。”不得不说，难怪老约翰能够做到警督这个位置退休。他确实是有一定口才在身上的。在监控后面的工作人员惊喜的目光中，卢克脸上从抗拒到出现了几分意动。就在他们以为目标就要答应了的时候，突然，轰的一声巨响，一枚狙击子弹从不远处的高楼射来，击中在卢克的眉心位置，让他的脑袋猛地后仰，身体向后连退数步。Ｏ（≧▽≦）Ｏ在指挥室内众人满脸问号的表情中，都准备开始庆功了的纽约警察局长雷.凯利勃然大怒，手里拿着对讲机，额头青筋暴起大吼：“是谁让你们开枪的，我不是说了吗，一切听指挥行动！！”“啊，局长，不是我啊......”“也不是我。”“是我？？！”纽约布鲁克林大桥附近的一栋高楼上，刚刚不怎么知道回事，突然扣下了扣板的狙击手满脸懵逼的表情。不是，他刚才没准备开枪啊，怎么就脑子一热扣动了扳机？？
content_en:
In the presidential suite.The clock hanging on the wall pointed to seven o'clock.When he left, there was already a glimmer of light in the gray sky outside the window.Some New Yorkers who got up early have already started their morning runs.Lu Bai turned on the TV, and as expected, it was full of smoke bombs released by American officials, such as saying that so and so had cheated on him, and there were several technology stocks on the Darkness section that reached their daily limit, but there was no news about Luke Duncan.When it comes to truly extraordinary power, the U.S. government has adopted a more rigorous approach that is different from its previous loose approach. Not only did everyone with knowledge of the matter sign the highest-level confidentiality agreement, but they also severely warned various social media outlets not to report any relevant news."Who said there is freedom of speech in the United States?" What he expected didn't happen, and Lu Bai felt a little depressed.However, he quickly adjusted and warned himself not to rush.First, he went to the restaurant downstairs to have a long-lost modern breakfast. After satisfying his appetite, Lu Bai turned his attention to the unlucky Luke Duncan....What should you do if you suddenly gain superpowers one day??The fantasy that everyone had in their second year of high school suddenly came true for Luke Duncan.As a client, he found that he was not as happy as he imagined.More.It is a kind of confusion after a great revenge has been avenged.He didn't know where his strange power came from, whether it was the mercy of the gods or a gift from the devil, and he didn't know what he should do next.After hurriedly escaping from his former 'home', he wandered aimlessly on the streets.Unknowingly, he came to the Brooklyn Bridge in New York where he had previously chosen to commit suicide.This bridge was built in 1869. The bridge was lifted 41 meters above the water by tens of thousands of steel cables. It was the longest suspension bridge in the world at that time and the first bridge built with steel in the world. When it was completed, it was considered the eighth wonder of the world after the seven wonders of the ancient world.It is for this reason that millions of tourists come here every year for sightseeing.Luke, who had changed his clothes, was inconspicuous among the many tourists.It wasn't until his senses became more sensitive after the changes in his body that he noticed some vague eyes staring at him from around him.He stopped suddenly and glanced around with some vigilance."The target stopped suddenly. It is very likely that he has noticed our presence and will execute plan A immediately." In a command room filled with screens, George Gentley, who had been awake all night, stared at the screen.In modern society, if the country is determined to find a person, it can turn him out even if he is burned to ashes.After calling up surveillance cameras across New York, the New York Police Department discovered Luke Duncan wandering the streets early.but.Since they are still unsure about the danger of the target and whether it is possible to be included, they have not taken any action yet and just sent people to keep a close eye on it.Unexpectedly, they were the first to be exposed now."Yes." George Gentry's order was quickly conveyed to the ears of the frontline personnel through the radio.On the Brooklyn Bridge in New York.

An old white man with gray hair in a plaid shirt turned to look at the young woman next to him helplessly, and warned: "Try not to speak later. Luke is a bit stubborn, just like his father. If you put pressure on him, it may have the opposite effect." "Understood." Christine, a tall policewoman with beautiful black hair, a heroic face, and a tall figure, nodded.The two of them were the executors of Plan A formulated by George Gentry.Among them, the old white man John is a retired New York policeman and a good friend of Luke's father during his lifetime.The policewoman Christine looks somewhat similar to Luke's mother. They both have beautiful black hair, and they are both of mixed Indian and white descent.According to the analysis of an expert think tank temporarily convened by the New York Police Department, the presence of such a woman during negotiations would help lower Luke Duncan's vigilance.And that's exactly what happened.When Luke, whose body muscles were already tense, saw the two of them walking towards him, he did not take action immediately.On the contrary, it was Old John who stepped forward and gave him a firm hug and thanked him: "Son, I have to thank you for saving Johnny's life and not letting me, an old man, lose my youngest son."???Old John's operation immediately put Luke out of control.He was silent for a while and then said in a low voice: "Uncle John, I think you came here not just to say this, right?" When he said this, Luke also turned his head and glanced at the policewoman Christine, who was standing next to Old John, and whose face was somewhat similar to his mother's."Of course." Although he came with a mission, Old John was very calm, "They plan to recruit you, so they asked me to do ideological work for you." "No..." Hearing this, Luke subconsciously wanted to refuse.But Old John waved his hand towards him and said, "Don't be nervous, kid. If you think about it carefully, you will know that this is not necessarily a bad thing, right??" "The high salary is far beyond the social status of ordinary people. As long as you want, you can let go of the past and start a new life. I think William and Anna will be happy about this if they know about this in heaven." It has to be said that it is no wonder that Old John can retire as a police inspector.He does have some eloquence in him.Under the surprised eyes of the staff behind the surveillance camera, Luke's face changed from resistance to a hint of emotion.Just when they thought the target was about to agree, suddenly, there was a loud bang, and a sniper bullet was shot from a tall building not far away, hitting Luke between the eyebrows, causing his head to snap back and his body to take several steps back.Ｏ（≧▽≦）O When everyone in the command room had expressions full of questions, New York Police Commissioner Ray Kelly, who was about to start celebrating, was furious. He held a walkie-talkie in his hand and shouted with veins on his forehead: "Who asked you to shoot? Didn't I tell you? Listen to everything."Command the action!!" "Ah, it's not me..." "It's me?!" The sniper who didn't know what was happening suddenly had a confused expression on his face.No, he wasn't ready to shoot just now, so why did he pull the trigger just because his mind was hot??
